The MEAs were prepared by arc melting the metallic elements with the purity above 99.95 wt% inside the chamber filled with low-pressure high-purity argon atmosphere. To ensure chemical homogeneity, the ingots were flipped over and re-melted at least 5 times.
After melted, the alloy was drop-cast into the water-cooled cupper mold with the size of 10 mm × 10 mm × 45 mm.
